typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsAbsIdx_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		PRODUCT_ID as decimal(38,0),
		INDEX_NAME as string,
		ABSINDEX_DEF_ID as decimal(38,0)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromcalypsocdsindexdef
fromcalypsocdsindexdef derive({Copy of ABSINDEX_DEF_ID} = toString(ABSINDEX_DEF_ID),
		{Copy of PRODUCT_ID} = toString(PRODUCT_ID),
		{Copy of INDEX_NAME} = INDEX_NAME) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		INDEX_NAME as string,
		PRODUCT_ID as string,
		ABSINDEX_DEF_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		INDEX_NAME = {Copy of INDEX_NAME},
		PRODUCT_ID,
		ABSINDEX_DEF_ID),
	partitionFileNames:[($totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsAbsIdx_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> totblcalypsotradeservProductCdsAbsIdx
